body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> iBiquity Digital Corporation, the developer of digital HD Radio technology for AM and FM audio and data broadcasting, highlights significant progress with HD Radio technology and a major increase in breadth and depth of HD Radio receivers.

As a sign of HD technology's rapid progress, the number of available receivers is approaching 100, almost double the SKU at retail last January. Additionally, eleven automakers have announced their commitment to backing HD Radio technology and more than 1,800 AM and FM stations are broadcasting in digital across the country with over 900 HD2 and HD3 multicast channels on the air.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
